extracted_factors.Label: Increased Land Surface Temperature
extracted_factors.Description: The study shows that coal mining activities directly increase the temperature of the land surface, affecting soil and vegetation.

extracted_factors.Label: Deforestation
extracted_factors.Description: Due to coal mining, forests are cleared, reducing carbon sinks and affecting climate regulation.

extracted_factors.Label: Environmental Degradation
extracted_factors.Description: Coal mining activities result in soil degradation, water cycle disruption, and pollute groundwater.

extracted_pain_points.description: Coal mining activities significantly increase surface temperatures, affecting local ecosystems.
Deforestation due to mining leads to climate imbalance and reduces carbon storage capacity.
Mining activities pollute groundwater, affecting local water quality and biodiversity.
